Aleppo | Turkish shelling on Kurdish areas injured elder woman and young girl

Aleppo province: SOHR activists have documented the injury of an elder woman in her 70s due to Turkish shelling on Al-Nayribiyah village, in addition to the injury of a girl under the age of 18, due to another Turkish shelling on Gharnata village. The two villages are located within Kurdish-held areas northern of Aleppo, where Turkish forces stationed in Jalbal and Anab villages in Afrin countryside fired artillery shells on the vicinity of Baina/Abin village in Shirawa district in Afrin countryside.

Moreover, Turkish forces fired rocket launchers on the road linking between Hassin, Qaramil villages, camps for livestock breeders and Gharnata farms, in addition to Tel Refaat centre, Ain Dakna and Bayloniyah villages.

Yesterday, SOHR activists reported that a member of the National Army was killed, and two others were wounded in a guided missile attack waged by Kurdish and regime forces on a Turkish military vehicle on Marea frontline in the northern countryside of Aleppo.
